Triple Red 7s Multiplier's prizes make it a game that pays many small prizes and few large ones. Of the prize money still unclaimed, nearly all is in wins under $1,000. The prize counts change every day, but this design does not.

The numbers for "Triple Red 7s Multiplier" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
802.headline: The prize mix in this game

803.body:
About a third of the tickets for "Triple Red 777s" have been sold. The game is near the midpoint of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, neither the tickets nor the top prizes are running out faster than the other.

The table below shows the full count for "Triple Red 777s", with every prize level included.

The table below shows the full count for "Diamond Bingo", with every prize level included.

805.headline: Prize table details

806.body:
"Win $50, $100 or $200" is about halfway through its run, with about half of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

Everything here about "Win $50, $100 or $200" comes from official Maryland lottery numbers, current through October 30.
